title: FFmpeg AV1: -crf 0 is lossless in one encoder only
fullTitle: FFmpeg AV1: -crf 0 Is Lossless in libaom, Not in libsvtav1

endCard.line: The full film is on the channel

scenes.narration: You type dash c r f zero for lossless. In lib A O M, you get it. In lib S V T A V one, you do not: the encoder read your zero as not set, and used thirty five. Measured on ffmpeg six point one point one and eight point one point two. Same flag, two encoders.
lib A O M, dash c r f zero. Two hundred thirty four kilobytes on eight point one point two, five point seven times the dash c r f thirty file. S S I M one. Decoded frames equal the source.
lib S V T A V one, dash c r f zero. The same bytes as no dash c r f, and the log says C R F thirty five. Sixty kilobytes, S S I M zero point nine eight eight five. Not lossless, on either build.

The same dash c r f thirty is not the same file. S V T writes sixty one kilobytes on six point one point one, eighty two on eight point one point two. lib A O M writes forty one on both. The number is not a shared scale.
Does dash c r f need dash b colon v zero? No, it does not. Next to dash c r f thirty it changes nothing in either encoder: identical packets and identical frames, on both builds.

A real bitrate does. Dash b colon v five hundred k, next to dash c r f thirty. lib A O M obeys: five hundred twelve kilobytes down to two hundred twenty three. S V T one point seven ignores it. S V T four point one refuses with an error.
Preset in S V T, ffmpeg six point one point one. Preset four, forty six kilobytes. Eight, sixty one. Twelve, ninety five: fifty five percent bigger than eight, and worse.
Keyframes, in four hundred frames. S V T puts them at zero, one sixty one and three twenty two. lib A O M only at zero. Dash g twenty five gives sixteen in both, one a second.

That decides seeking. To reach frame three hundred, S V T runs one hundred forty frames. lib A O M runs three hundred one. With dash g twenty five: one. The price for lib A O M: eighteen percent more bytes on six point one point one.

The rules. Dash c r f zero is lossless in lib A O M only. Skip dash b colon v zero. Measure your own preset. Set dash g yourself. Check before you ship. Not tested: real footage, players, other builds, other presets.
